alternative_generating_fit.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

law.null_rule: Same a,d,n,productivity ratio,beta,trigger,stress law with eta=0; mark likelihood cancels

parameters.normalization: kappa=(1-r)*exp(beta*r*Q), so E[kappa]=1 under fixed Exp(beta); g=exp(gamma*(Q-1)),gamma=.75*log(10)

starts.trigger_n_null: Not used; n supplied in both methods
starts.both_null_zip: Not used in this stage; original20 fields retained only in pinned historical authority
starts.alternative: Two starts from each cell selected matching null, append eta0 or eta.2 and reoptimize every estimated continuous parameter
starts.known_known: Fixed null evaluates true nuisance once; optimize eta from0 and.2
starts.retained_subsets: Only exact eta0 matching null within each method is eligible. Eta* and known_known winners are witness-only; never change background starts/selection.
starts.tie_rule: Select lowest NLL; exact ties retain first canonical grid/start/subset order

solver.retry_options: Original start,bounds,maxiter100,ftol1e-10,gtol2e-6 unchanged; CPU200 changes only maxls

n0_face.start: Original start with n fixed exactly0; retain all other free coordinates

acceptance.nonworsening: max(returned_fun,recomputed_CPU16,recomputed_CUDA16)<=min(finite original-start objective,finite validated failed-returned candidate objective)+1e-8

diagnostics: finite full and bound-projected gradient norms or explicit nonrepresentability
matching-null and global eta0 nesting differences
solver.failure_policy: Every required start in a method must resolve: known_known2,background_estimated4,one supplied trigger cell. Unresolved orresource-capped method remainsunknown; validatedKK survivesBGfailure, dependentBG requiresvalidatedKK. Benchmarkfirstunresolvedcasestops; no failed-start omission or case replacement.
solver.pinned_source_policy: Import exact iteration20 fit_start and RestrictedHistory by source hashes; fallback code unchanged. n supplied, so n0-face tier is inapplicable to these methods.

required_controls: Exact20 RestrictedHistory and fit_start source hashes; no numerical optimizer changes
2+4 start records and original null/alt initialization/eta0 selection
one eta* and2background-superset witnesses, never inserted
validatedKK reuse afterBG interruption, no promotion of optimization-only
failed/timecap method retained and dependentBG blocked; no failure-to-zero
no duplicate workers/IDs and exact source/input cache rejection
validation.GLR_primary: Direct event log-intensity ratio plus stable background compensator difference and analytic trigger compensator difference. Never obtain primary GLR by subtracting large full NLL totals.
validation.GLR_background_difference: sum_q w*(-B0*expm1((a1-a0)+(d1-d0)*x-eta1*G)); add n0*C_H0-n1*C_H1 for selected different trigger/n
validation.common_mark_density: Fixed beta exponential mark term cancels across all candidates including r-grid; store separately, optimize ground likelihood.

eta_star.rule: Known/known selected alt NLL must be no worse than fixed eta* feasible-point NLL within1e-4; direct GLR check against2*oracle L has its own1e-4 absolute shortfall gate at16/32

cross_procedure.rule: At common CUDA16, background_estimated null and alternative must each be no worse than selected known_known feasible point by>1e-4; witnesses only

numerical_witnesses.violation: Retain unresolved search/numerical gate; no insertion or hidden initialization repair
numerical_witnesses.interpretation: Only component likelihood nesting follows from family inclusion; GLRs, calibration thresholds and power need not be ordered; witnesses do not certify a global optimum

provenance.scope: Scientific recipe extraction only. Historical campaign permissions and counts do not authorize or define this run.
